trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Verified the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — the most recent version with a healthy production history — across all regions. (No change-manager approval needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.)
3. **Confirmed recovery**: service is now healthy in all regions, error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommend follow-up: diagnose the v2.3.1 regression (v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, suggesting a known-bad build) before attempting a redeploy.
